params.1273: Summon a spirit wolf to aid you in combat.
params.1274: If you need a new pouch, you can obtain the ingredients from Magestix and then click on the obelisk to make it.
params.1275: <col=FFFFFF>Right-click</col> the <col=FFFFFF>wolf pouch</col> in your inventory and choose <col=FFFFFF>summon</col>.
params.2225: Summoned familiars help you in combat, but you can also find familiars help you with non-combat activities like mining and fishing.
